statement.title: Statement

CoverageEntry.description:
Units of the official source (articles, provisions, annexes) and what the pack does with
them: covered by named requirements, or excluded with a reason in ES and EN.
CoverageEntry.title: CoverageEntry

CriterionText.description:
An official text shown next to an incident flag, copied from the act (rule 10). For
criteria that are not measures, so they stay out of the self-assessment register.
CriterionText.title: CriterionText

statement.default: Generated by Atesta from the organization's own records. Not a certification. / Generado por Atesta a partir de los registros de la propia organización. No es una certificación.
statement.title: Statement

ExpectedAccess.description: Exactly what the customer grants: the allowlist of the connection's version.
ExpectedAccess.title: ExpectedAccess

ExpectedEvidence.description:
What an auditor is likely to ask for, in Atesta's own words with the guide reference.
A candidate until the owner signs it: a signature is the reviewer's name and the date.
ExpectedEvidence.title: ExpectedEvidence

FileOut.description:
An uploaded document (evidence-file-uploads spec). The storage key stays in the API.

scan_status: the malware scan (evidence-malware-scanning spec); only `no_threats_found`, or
`not_scanned` in local development, can be downloaded.
FileOut.title: FileOut

FileUploads.description: What the upload form may offer: nothing when no store is configured.
FileUploads.title: FileUploads

GoogleSubjectIn.description: The super admin Atesta reads as; the primary domain only when it differs (issue 398).
GoogleSubjectIn.title: GoogleSubjectIn

GuideReference.description: Where a guide says it: cited, never copied (requirement-register spec, issue 226).
GuideReference.title: GuideReference

IncidentCriterion.description:
What explains an incident flag (recorded-routines spec): a requirement of the pack, or an
official text given inline.
IncidentCriterion.title: IncidentCriterion

LastVerification.description: What the last verification found missing or extra, and what it cannot read.
LastVerification.title: LastVerification

PageReference.description: A section and page of the profile's own guide (its first reference).
PageReference.title: PageReference

ProfileOut.description: A pack's scope profile as the scope step offers it (requirement-register spec).
ProfileOut.title: ProfileOut

statement.default: Generated by Atesta from the organization's own records. Not a certification. / Generado por Atesta a partir de los registros de la propia organización. No es una certificación.
statement.title: Statement

ReportingClock.description:
A reporting deadline copied from the official text (recorded-routines spec). It starts when
the organization became aware of the incident, when it classified the incident as significant
(`starts: classified`), or when the clock named in `after` was met. A classified clock may
keep an outer limit in hours from awareness, which lapses when classification is later.
ReportingClock.title: ReportingClock

RequirementContext.description:
Official text of one requirement (content model v2). Selection tables by category or
dimension are optional; an act also published in English carries its official English text.
RequirementContext.title: RequirementContext

ScopeGuide.description:
How to value the system before recording the scope (requirement-register spec, issue 225):
ordered steps on the pack's dimension axis, and the category each level leads to.
ScopeGuide.title: ScopeGuide

ScopeGuideOut.description: How to value the system, from the pack (requirement-register spec, issue 225).
ScopeGuideOut.title: ScopeGuideOut

ScopeGuideStep.description: One valuation question: an asset type and one dimension key, in Atesta's own words.
ScopeGuideStep.title: ScopeGuideStep

ScopeProfile.description:
A published compliance profile as a scope option (requirement-register spec, issue 227):
one value per requirement of the pack, a level or `n.a.`. The guide is cited, never copied.
A candidate until the owner signs it, like expected evidence.
ScopeProfile.title: ScopeProfile

TermLabel.description:
A readable label for an official scope term (axis, dimension key or level). Authored text,
not official: the stored scope keeps the official term.
TermLabel.title: TermLabel
